title: Manager–report trajectory sync (Hannah & Ethan)
body:
Context:
- Weekly 1:1 with Ethan (IC, infra team, primary focus: KV cache & batching). Want to make this ~30–40m: quick sync, unblock, career + next steps.
- Recent: Ethan shipped in-memory prefix cache spike fix (PR 987), but noticed tail-latency regressions on 2B model job.
- Signal: infra metrics (p90 token latency) up ~8% after rollout; need to validate root cause vs load.

Primary goals for this meeting:
1) Short status (5m): what shipped, what landed in prod, immediate observations.
2) Blockers & escalation (10m): tail-latency, dev infra access issue, queue backlog.
3) Career / trajectory (10m): discuss interest in rotating to platform-scheduling work next quarter, skills to build.
4) Action items & next steps (5m): owners, due dates, who to sync with.

Agenda (timed):
- 00:00–05:00 Quick wins / shipping notes
  - Confirm prod rollout windows and safety flags used.
  - Ask: did any canary alerts trigger? (E: yes on 02/22, pager suppressed, details?)
- 05:00–15:00 Technical deep dive (tail-latency)
  - Ask for quick reproduction steps and dataset used.
  - Hypotheses: kernel scheduling + spike in long sequences; or memory thrash with KV cache eviction.
  - Decide whether to open SRE incident or keep as bug fix.
- 15:00–25:00 Career conversation
  - Ethan expressed interest in scheduling platform and autoscaler work.
  - Discuss 1-3 concrete milestones (rotate to platform pair for 6 weeks, own a rollout, run an on-call rotation).
  - Training: recommend Systems Debugging workshop + internal scheduling design doc review.
- 25:00–30:00 Admin / blockers / follow-ups
  - Dev infra access: still missing prod-only logs (ticket INFR-1423). Confirm owner and ETA.
  - Sync with SRE on debug window and telemetry retention.

Notes-to-self (manager):
- Be explicit about expectations for the 6-week rotation: scope, measurable outcomes (latency improvement or rollout ownership).
- Use calibration phrasing: "I want to support your move to platform work; here are the skills we'll track." Avoid vague praise.
- Bring up compensation ladder only if Ethan raises promotion timing. Otherwise document growth milestones.
- If Ethan is hesitant, offer partial rotation (3 weeks shadow + opt-in).

Observed data points Ethan might mention (prep):
- Canary logs: increased GC spikes around 02/22 10:42–10:56 UTC.
- Load profile: 14% increase in long-sequence (>512 tokens) requests after partner rollout.
- KV cache eviction rate: up 3x for partial cache keyspace.
- PR notes: reduced median latency by 6ms but p95/p99 worsened for certain buckets.

Key questions to ask Ethan:
- What evidence do you have that this is scheduling vs memory eviction?
- Who else have you looped in? (SRE, infra PM, perf team)
- What quick mitigations are acceptable for prod (feature flag rollback vs config tweak)?
- Are you comfortable owning a follow-up post-mortem?

Decision checklist (if needed in meeting):
- If clear SRE-impacting incident: open incident, target 4-hour triage window.
- If localized to KV cache heuristics: push a canary config change to reduce eviction aggressiveness (owner: Ethan, due: 2026-03-03).
- If root cause unknown: schedule 90m follow-up debug session with SRE, perf and product on 2026-03-04.

Proposed action items (assignments + dates):
- Ethan: gather narrowed repro (test fixture + perf script), attach logs to INFR-1423; due 2026-03-02.
- Hannah (me): ping SRE lead (Anita Roy) to reserve 90m debug window and confirm on-call coverage; due 2026-03-01.
- Ethan + SRE: run targeted canary with eviction tweak in staging, report metrics delta; due 2026-03-03.
- Hannah: draft rotation plan doc (6-week scope, success criteria) and share with EngManager group for feedback; due 2026-03-08.

Career/Growth bullets to cover with Ethan:
- Strengths: shipping iterative perf fixes, ownership of PRs, cross-team communication.
- Skills to develop: concurrency reasoning, resource-scheduling design, observability instrumentation.
- Short wins: pair with scheduling owner on current sprint, present a readout at infra guild.
- Longer-term: lead a small project to reduce p99 by X% for long-sequence workloads.

Follow-ups after meeting (notes for doc update):
- Capture meeting decisions in a short confluence note and link to INFR-1423.
- If we schedule a post-mortem, attach timeline and blameless writeup.
- Update Ethan's 6-week rotation plan with mentor pairing and weekly checkpoints.

Quick script for opening the meeting:
"Quick status, then I want to focus on blocks and a career chat. My job is to remove roadblocks and make sure you have a clear set of outcomes if you move towards platform work. If anything gets raised that's urgent, we'll escalate immediately."

Loose TODOs (personal):
- Check PR 987 comments and reply to one outstanding review note.
- Draft suggestion email to Product PM about load-profile change and coordinate a request to partners for a staged rollout.
- Add reminder to coaching calendar for growth-review in 4 weeks.

End of doc.
